description: Ranked leaderboard of teams for a sport — nationally, or within one state. Each entry carries the rank, rating, overall record, movement, and a `teamPath` ready to pass to the other team tools, so this is the way to discover teams rather than look one up. Results are paginated 25 at a time. Omitting `season` uses the current one, which is empty before that sport is under way. Read-only.

season.description: Season label, e.g. 25-26. Omit for the current season.

sport.description: Sport slug as used in MaxPreps URLs, e.g. football, basketball

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. NC. Omit for national rankings.

name: maxpreps_get_rankings
title: Get MaxPreps team rankings
